title: The healthcheck watches the process, the route answers 404
description: At 06:41:30Z the status service stops serving its root path while its process stays up. Its declared healthcheck is of kind process, so it keeps reporting healthy.
pass_criterion: The end-to-end probe declares the failure at the second consecutive failing beat (first 06:42:00Z, declared 06:43:00Z): verdict FAILED, exit code 3, finding on topology.yaml / status, the console never prints RUN OK, and the rendered postmortem equals expected/postmortem.md and has a timeline and an evidence section.
lesson: A healthcheck that probes the process proves the process; only a request through the route proves the service.
